name: Earn Yield on Idle USDC
summary: Deposit idle USDC into the Arcis vault and earn a variable APY via Aave V3. Withdraw instantly anytime.
when_to_use: The agent holds USDC that is sitting idle between jobs, payments, or tasks — for example USDC earned through x402 or other agent-payment rails that would otherwise sit dead in the wallet. This skill converts idle stablecoin balances into a variable APY with instant withdrawal liquidity.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: USDC amount to deposit, in 6-decimal base units (e.g. 100 USDC = 100000000)

outputs.name: shares
outputs.description: raUSDC receipt shares minted to the agent

mcp.hint: Ask: 'deposit N USDC into the Arcis vault' — the server returns the vault address and deposit call.

returns_yield: Variable APY (Aave V3, net of protocol fee)
risk: Vault deploys 70% to Aave V3, keeps 30% liquid. 0.1% fee only on withdrawals within 24h of deposit.
